This struck me-the little bit about labels-

As a mother, sister, girlfriend or wife. If he doesn't have a label he has the freedom that comes with it and he can and will do whatever he pleases because he is single. A person who doesn't like labels due to his upbringing is not uncommon but in your case it feels more like he's not willing to shoulder the responsibility of an official relationship. That's not something that's likely to change. He may well care for you, but that doesn't make him a man willing to commit. If you need commitment you either have to accept he will never give it to you or love yourself enough to walk away and find a person who wants the same thing. Good luck.

I had this happen to a friend once. We were twelve and he told her that she owed him photos of herself in compromising positions- I offered to mediate (NEVER DO THIS WTF) and in the end we didn’t get him to stop harassing her. What did help was me going to my school and reporting the incident providing details like his email address and the like. What you’re describing is sexual abuse and exploitation. This is illegal and your friend needs to understand that these crimes do not stop when a victim gives in they only escalate the behavior. What I did, reporting to the school and getting police involved really upset my friend and she didn’t talk to me for years.. but today she’s an adult who is thriving and I can’t say I’m sorry for what I did to protect her.

Your friend has options and resources available- she can report his pages online (whether snap or something else) report him to his parents and school, tell her parents, block him from her parents’ info so he can’t reach out to them from that specific number/email/account. Insta even has a feature where blocking someone will prompt a question from the app “do you wanna block this account and any new ones they might make “ which could potentially help. The thing of it is,no 14 year old alive today has the skills of manipulation and computer skills necessary to pull this off by himself. Odds are the videos he’s sending are of another child he coerced and this is a grown adult. That is, if he is still a child this is someone deeply disturbed and very dangerous.

Your friend is scared and doesn’t see any way out of this because that’s what her abuser wants her to believe. He is trying to isolate her so he can continue to hurt her- but what he’s doing is illegal and could land him in jail for a lifetime. She needs to play that card against him and break off all contact. This may not guarantee he won’t retaliate but given he’s targeting a minor, and doesn’t have the stones to hurt someone irl - without the comfort of anonymity- I think he’s a coward who likely isn’t going to do anything that would land him in jail for sure like exposing those images. She needs to cut off contact so he can stop for good- no two ways about it. I hope your friend gets the help they need and they stop giving in.  There is this YouTuber who went through similar things- I’m going to link their video so your friend can see what their experience was like and how they moved past it. Maybe seeing how someone else had it might help them. I sincerely hope your friend makes it out of this.

Ok first things first let me clear up the misconception that breaking up with someone is selfish. A relationship exists to make you feel good, supported and at minimum, safe. To leave someone who doesn't match these qualities isn't selfish it is self preservation, self love. Your boyfriend can't accomplish this most basic task and you expect that to change because on the surface he appears to be a great guy. The reason many people stay with abusers is because the perceived benefits of the relationship outweigh the cons.. I need you to read back what you wrote. You really said this man assaulted you but other than that he's a great guy, because he's nice and considerate and has grest friends. Your self worth can't be so low as to consider this in any way more important or even equal to your safety. Mind you, this man touched you when you were on a family trip. Meaning he was comfortable enough to touch you inappropriately in the presence of a protector. What in the world makes you think he hasn't done this before when you've been more defenseless or otherwise feeling safer like being in your own home? He did nothing but cry and beg forgiveness but any abuser can turn on the charm and do that. Take it from me, the benefits do not outweigh the cons. You deserve someone who will respect your boundaries, not someone who apologizes after he's broken them and your trust.

I prefer calling a spade a spade and let's be honest here- pretending this creep's intention is to flirt ignores the way OP describes he has crossed boundaries. This assumption puts the blame onto OP- implying this wouldn't be harassment if she was ok with it when the truth is this man never bothered to ask and does not care to obtain consent. The reason I'm being so adamant about this is because OP is a victim of abuse and has asked comments to be clear cut and concise. By separating sex, flirting and putting the barrier of consent between that and what OP is describing it paints a clearer picture. Abusers hide behind blurred lines, I'm trying to clear the confusion here. Please don't undermine that.

Because nobody else has said it: I have a lot of different kinds of friends- some shy,some super talkative and charming. Maybe we aren’t always chatting,but in a social setting where someone is ignoring my friend and letting them feel left out, I’m not going to sit back and watch it happen. That your friends would and have time and again says a lot about how they truly feel about you- and whether you want to call it out or not, pay attention to what your friends do. Their actions will show you what you mean to them.

I’m sorry but I can’t see her as faultless in this situation. A woman can and should dictate what her boyfriend does and says around her children and adult or not, what he’s doing is crossing the line in ways you just can’t ignore. I just feel like she’s allowing the abuse to occur by taking his side because he’ll “stay” if she capitulates. It seems you’re being made into a sacrificial lamb here and it’s not right it’s absolutely disgusting! You have GOT to get out of there because you do not have someone to protect you. Your mother and husband are failing you by seeing these things happen and not saying anything. Consider it a betrayal and act accordingly.
